svg.title: Employment type and status: employee, contractor, external, probation — SoftTrack web design mockup (#247)
svg.desc: An account is active or it is not, and SoftTrack cannot tell an employee from a contractor, a client or the account an integration signs in with. Employment type and status are a history with effective dates, set by HR, with an end date and a probation end set ahead of time; payroll, headcount and the directory read them.
